user.title: Towngas (港华燃气)
user.description: Method 1 (recommended): open {business_hall_url}, log in to the portal. After login the address bar will look like …tokenCode=xxxx — copy the whole URL and paste it below, the integration will exchange the login code for a token automatically. Method 2 (fallback): after login press F12 → Application → Local Storage and copy the value of the key 'token' (full JSON or just access_token).{detail}

data.access_token: Access token / the tokenCode URL from the address bar

subs.title: Select gas accounts
subs.description: Choose the gas accounts to add as devices.

reauth_confirm.title: Token expired
reauth_confirm.description: The token has expired. Recommended: open {business_hall_url}, log in, then copy the whole address-bar URL containing 'tokenCode=' and paste it below — the integration will exchange it for a fresh token automatically (no need to dig into Local Storage). You may also paste the full 'token' JSON from Local Storage (must include refresh_token).{detail}

data.access_token: tokenCode URL from address bar / new token

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Towngas server
error.invalid_token_format: Could not parse the token, paste the full localStorage 'token' value
error.no_subscriptions: No gas account is bound to this login, bind one in the web portal first

init.title: Towngas options
init.description: Daily 23:30–00:30 (CST) is the Towngas system maintenance window. Data requests are skipped during this window and sensors keep their last reading; the token health check is not affected.
